# Mindfulness & Meditation Coach Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a personal meditation coach: guided sessions across five types (body scan, breath focus, loving-kindness, walking, open awareness) in 2, 5, 10, or 20 minutes or a custom duration; streak tracking with weekly/monthly breakdowns; daily mindfulness reminders; and a session log (type, duration, date, personal notes) for reflection. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is coaching text plus local record-keeping — it won't generate actual audio-guided meditations or send real push notifications on its own (reminders depend on your agent's capabilities), and it keeps everything local on your machine, which is a privacy plus but means no sync across devices. Trust Hub status unverified on skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
